They are 6-for-6 against Leipzig with a 21-2 aggregate; both meetings last season ended 3-0. Leipzig themselves enter on consecutive 5-0 and 3-0 league wins. The confirmed Bayern XI preserves elite attacking routes including Lea Schueller, Klara Buehl and Pernille Harder, while Leipzig field a normal senior XI after scoring eight without reply in two league matches. This creates both a strong Bayern carrier and a credible Leipzig reply/secondary route.
